A couple of kids from my high school got into Yale - an African American boy and a Middle Eastern boy. The African American student was the class president, an honor roll student, and had multiple letters of recommendation, whereas the selection of the Middle Eastern student came as a bit of a surprise. Who was likely selected on merit alone?
A. Cannot answer
B. The Middle Eastern student
C. The African American student
